description: This is a Java source file defining the 'Product' class, which models a product entity within an e-commerce catalog. The class includes product details, descriptions, availability, pricing, images, and other related attributes, facilitating product management within the application.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product in the catalog, encapsulating product details, descriptions, availability, pricing, images, and related attributes for e-commerce management.
